title: NC-PLUS-LOOPBREAK-FM-github-app-org-access: Add failure-escalation rule: after 3 dispatch failures, block item and flag missing capability to portfolio-manager
body:
**Owner:** portfolio-manager
**Trigger:** the backlog item PLUS-LOOPBREAK-FM-github-app-org-access was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/needs_code_bridge.py --probe PLUS-LOOPBREAK-FM-github-app-org-access
**Status:** closed

Add failure-escalation rule: after 3 dispatch failures, block item and flag missing capability to portfolio-manager

Backlog done check: A backlog rule exists that on the 3rd consecutive dispatch failure of an item sets it to blocked, records the failure reasons, and creates a capability-gap note naming either a different doer, a smaller split, or the missing capability.

Triage: Requires coding to implement failure-escalation rule | first step: Write a Cloudflare Worker script to detect 3rd dispatch failure

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 26.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
